name: San Francisco City College Adult Education
description: Free adult education including GED, ESL, citizenship, and career training classes
fullDescription: City College of San Francisco offers free adult education classes including GED preparation, ESL, citizenship, and career training.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free GED/HiSET and high school diploma preparation
- Free ESL (English as a Second Language) classes
- U.S. Citizenship test preparation
- Basic skills, math, reading, writing, and computer literacy
- Short-term career education certificates (business, culinary, custodial, home health aide, and more)
- Pre-apprenticeship training and programs for adults with disabilities
- Classes for parents, guardians, and foster parents
- Multiple locations throughout San Francisco
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the CCSF Adult Education website or a CCSF center
2. Choose a program (English, high school diploma, citizenship, or job skills)
3. Take placement assessment if required
4. Register for noncredit classes
5. Most adult education classes are free of charge
keywords: adult school, San Francisco, CCSF, GED, ESL, English, citizenship, high school diploma, adult education, free classes, continuing education
